prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Korean silver fox goddess luminous milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and smooth dewy skin elegant silver-era maturity, mid 40s, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white layered tousled shag cut — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 59% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 36%, 52% and 85% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but geyser plasma eruption formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and ORANGE glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Face: a real photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration and not a CG render — visible pores and fine skin grain, the fine natural expression lines of her age around the eyes and mouth, faint peach-fuzz hairs catching the light, natural tonal variation with a soft flush on the cheeks, a few small natural beauty marks, slight natural asymmetry, eyes with real wet catchlights and individual lashes, lips with real vertical texture — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
